title: Data pipeline
compatibleOperations: Only operations compatible with {{modality}} are shown.
lockedNodeNote: This node stays fixed at the {{position}}.

source.label: Source
source.description: Starting point of the data pipeline.

output.label: Prepared dataset
output.description: Defines how data is delivered to training. The final shape updates when applying the pipeline.

validate.label: Validate quality
validate.description: Checks shapes, targets and invalid values. Serves as an early control before preparing the dataset.

deduplicate.label: Remove duplicates
deduplicate.description: Detects identical entries and keeps a single copy. Helps prevent a repeated sample from appearing across different splits.

finite_filter.label: Exclude non-finite
finite_filter.description: Discards samples containing NaN or infinity before computing statistics or training.

normalize.label: Normalize variables
normalize.description: Computes Z-Score or Min-Max using only train and reuses those parameters on validation, test and inference.

clip.label: Limit extremes
clip.description: Clips values to quantiles learned on train. Useful when a few outliers dominate the scale.

resize.label: Resize
resize.description: Changes the resolution of all images. For segmentation it applies the same change to the mask using nearest neighbor.

center_crop.label: Center crop
center_crop.description: Crops a reproducible central region. Image and mask remain perfectly aligned.

convert_channels.label: Convert channels
convert_channels.description: Converts images between RGB and grayscale and automatically updates the input contract.

image_normalize.label: Normalize image
image_normalize.description: Makes sense for CNNs: centers each channel and stabilizes optimization. Mean and standard deviation are computed using only train and stored for inference.

random_flip.label: Random flip
random_flip.description: Horizontally flips a proportion of images each epoch. For segmentation and reconstruction it also transforms the target.

random_rotate90.label: 90° rotation
random_rotate90.description: Randomly rotates by multiples of 90°. Keeps image and mask aligned and avoids interpolation artifacts.

color_jitter.label: Color and contrast
color_jitter.description: Varies brightness and contrast only during train. Increases robustness to lighting without changing geometry or labels.

random_noise.label: Random noise
random_noise.description: Adds independent noise during train. Useful for robustness and denoising; validation and test remain deterministic.

validation.endpoints: Source and output must remain at the ends.
validation.outOfOrder: {{label}} is out of order; move it before applying.
